title: Funnel neckline shirt
content:
"This is my second post as a CONNECT supporter for CLO SET CONNECT! In this video, I showcase my workflow for creating a cotton jersey shirt with a funnel neckline in CLO 3D. I used tools like 'Pen on Garment' and 'Pen on Avatar' to shape and refine the design directly in 3D. Watch the full process on YouTube and discover new techniques to enhance your creations!"

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/389be5752da449e29919500a0f4ada49/images/162d14936da745159240bd6a3936ecb5doll_56.png)

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ta-_Y8Py_s4

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Your tutorial is fantastic! The approach is straightforward, and it's an excellent guide that's easy to understand. I think many users will find your tutorial helpful and will benefit from it. Thank you for sharing!💞
Reply 1: So sweet thank you. your comments encourage me to make more and more tutorials.

Comment 2: That’s seriously cool! Wish I could do this, but I can’t. Because I, with my years of training as a patterns cutter and then working as a bespoke tailor, am simply unable to create garments using Pen tool. First, because for me there must be a technical basis to build a garment upon. What I mean is a “basic, professionally drafted pattern”. Second, because I view Clo3D as a pattern prototyping tool rather than a 3D garment creating app. And last, but not least: because I always consider real life’s practical and comfort aspects of the garments I design.Would you consider using for your amazing creations one of the patterns I sell? I would provide it free of charge. And I would be honoured.
Reply 1: Thanks for your comment. Your job is valuable and that is what i always say to the fashion students," perfect visual does not mean perfect fit "so i encourage them to learn at least the essential basic knowledge of drawing patterns and therefore CLO has efficient tools in 2d window.I appreciate your offer and i will keep it in my mind and again thanks for your time and comment.
content_description: Showcasing a step-by-step CLO 3D workflow for designing a cotton jersey funnel neckline shirt using advanced tools to inspire and educate fashion creators.

title: ✨ Excited to share my 2024 3D clothing design collection! 🌟
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/4afc5ea240ba42a4ba1e9ae515d62006Slide%2016_9%20-%20167.jpg)

Hello everyone, I am a 3D fashion designer and 3D artist from China.​​​​​​​

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/9996a7f67da641009077851b39e08dbf11111248.png)

I would like to share a series of 3D fashion works I completed in 2024, which were mainly designed for non-realistic characters. These pieces come from different projects, which I have re-rendered and compiled into this collection to review my learning journey and project practice in 2024. All of them were created using CLO3D and Marvelous Designer for 3D clothing design and rendered in C4D. I also use Blender for creating and modifying some basic models.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/25fe6c53a74142b8b783386e95b6c1d511111252.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/72c84c3dabfd4cc98216bfbfd025ef5311111251.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5da3fde3a8454da29e18681a91f265fc11111250.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5914b4d7673f42b4af2a70b330bfa8e611111253.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/0b796677874a4748afa4afa87b6a92ef11111258.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/4884efe82a6347fbb8405b380139f77411111254.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/5b796c6c2b9245c09172d1eb7beb2dae11111255.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/1a5626e0ccaa40879b32763840efb33011111256.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/15d89c5528e0445896e0eace103f12e511111257.png)

In my continuous learning process, I have deeply experienced the infinite possibilities of CLO3D and Marvelous Designer. These software connect multiple industries, integrate virtual reality, and link various styles. Throughout 2024, I not only created many realistic-style garments but also explored various styles including non-realistic IP characters and realistic fashion short films. In the future, I will continue to learn other 3D software to expand the boundaries of my creative work.✨

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/4e775ae032a2474390c98336db2f4dfe11111249.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/6c57435a1e1a4293b41e995823681264Slide%2016_9%20-%20169.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/638c4203bd8f4a9ca9742ecf1fa38c34/images/ab911161c34d4394b3bf6f666b753724Slide%2016_9%20-%20168.jpg)
